categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the medical device industry, specifically focusing on blood purification and ward care medical consumables. Main product lines include extracorporeal circulation blood pathways for blood dialysis, one-time use arteriovenous puncture needles, one-time use integrated oxygen inhalation tubes, and feeding tubes. The company also develops pharmaceutical products related to blood dialysis and is expanding into CRRT (continuous renal replacement therapy) equipment and accessories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in high-precision injection molding, high-precision catheter extrusion, and automated assembly processes. Key manufacturing capabilities include precision mold design and modification, high-speed precision injection molding technology, and high-precision automated detection and statistical analysis technology. The company operates with a combination of automated and manual production lines with flexible manufacturing capabilities to respond quickly to market demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include hospitals and medical institutions across China, with terminal hospital coverage exceeding 1,000 hospitals including over 450 tertiary hospitals. The company serves patients requiring blood dialysis treatment, CRRT therapy, and ward care. International markets include customers in Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and Africa. Major international customers include Fresenius Medical Care, Baxter Medical, Medtronic, Nippon, and Braun Medical.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across 31 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions in China. International operations span Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and Africa. The company has established subsidiaries in Singapore, Hong Kong, Sweden, Thailand, and the United States. Recent expansion includes establishing a production base in Thailand scheduled for 2026 completion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the medical device supply chain. It manufactures medical consumables and equipment that are distributed through both direct sales to medical institutions and indirect sales through distributors. The company also engages in upstream activities through research and development of pharmaceutical products related to blood dialysis.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating new product research and development, expanding product categories from medical devices to pharmaceutical products, enhancing automation and informatization levels, and pursuing international expansion. R&D focus areas include high-end blood dialysis pathways, dialysis concentrates, dialyzers, CRRT replacement solutions, and pharmaceutical products. The company invested over 60 million yuan in R&D in 2024, representing 14.43% of operating revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of medical devices and consumables. Revenue is recognized when control of products transfers to customers, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company operates through both distribution channels (68.22% of revenue) and direct sales channels (31.84% of revenue). International sales are conducted through both direct and indirect channels with settlement primarily in US dollars.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in blood purification consumables with strong brand recognition. It competes with international companies including Fresenius Medical Care, Baxter Medical, and Nippon. The company holds the distinction of being the first domestic enterprise to obtain CRRT-specific extracorporeal circulation pathway registration. The company is recognized as a national-level specialized and sophisticated 'little giant' enterprise and a Zhejiang Province 'hidden champion' enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved operating revenue of 418.96 million yuan in 2024, representing 9.98% growth compared to 2023. However, net profit attributable to shareholders declined to negative 0.74 million yuan from 63.57 million yuan in 2023, primarily due to increased management, R&D, and operating expenses. Total assets reached 1.79 billion yuan as of December 31, 2024. The company is in a growth phase with significant capital investments in new production facilities and product development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product quality and safety as core differentiators, with comprehensive quality control systems spanning research, procurement, production, and sales. Products are designed with clinical needs as the primary focus, offering user-friendly and safe solutions. The company provides extensive product specifications (over 200 types for blood pathways) to meet diverse clinical requirements. International certifications including FDA registration, CE certification, and ISO 13485 quality management system certification demonstrate commitment to global quality standards. The company's long-term focus on blood purification and ward care specialization provides deep technical expertise and market understanding.
